meta.note: Keyed register > question id, mirroring reviews/data/samples.json with the register as an extra top level. Each record names its taskType, and its paragraph labels are the MOVE labels of that task type, so Plan and Sample describe the same four moves in the same words. Written to answer the live question bank: every content point in emails-questions-*.json is addressed, and the salutation/sign-off pair follows the task type. The previous file was replaced rather than extended — it held five scenarios written twice at different registers, which is a valuable contrast but a different axis from the rest of the pipeline, and none of its scenarios matched the questions a learner can actually choose.
